verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਾਲ ਮੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan kaal mai akaal kaal biaal bikh maareeaai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-conscious person enjoys the benefits of all the nine treasures in the company of holy men. Despite living in the wheel of time, he remains protected from its wrath. He destroys the poison of the time like snake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan kul akuleen bhe dhubidhaa nivaareeaai ||

en.bdb: He drinks deep the elixir of the Lord's name sitting in the dust of the feet of holy men. He becomes bereft of caste pride and is able to remove all differences of high and low from his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਕੀ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan sahaj samaadh nij aasan kee taareeaai ||

en.bdb: In the company of holy men and enjoying the treasure of elixir like Naam, he remains engrossed in his self and attached consciously in a state of equipoise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਆਰੀਐ ॥੧੨੭॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh saadh charanaamirat param padh gurmukh pa(n)th abigat gat niaareeaai ||127||

en.bdb: Relishing the elixir like Naam of the Lord in the company of the holy men, he attains the supreme state. The path of Guru-conscious people is beyond description. It is imperishable and celestial. (127)
